shortDescription: Manages FAST template sets on BIG-IP

options.name: force
options.description: When set to C(true), any existing template with the same name is overwritten by the new import.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the FAST template set to create or remove. When C(present) the name must correspond to the basename of the uploaded zip file without the file extension. Parameter is optional when C(state) is C(present), the name is derived from the basename of the uploaded zip file. Parameter is mandatory when C(state) is C(absent), and disregarded when C(state) is C(purge).

options.name: source
options.description: Full path to a template set file to be imported into the BIG-IP. File must be in a zip format, other formats will raise an error when attempting to activate the template sets. Parameter is required when C(state) is C(present)

options.name: state
options.description: When C(state) is C(present), the FAST template set is uploaded and created on the device. When C(state) is C(absent), ensures the existing FAST template set is removed. When C(state) is C(purge), ensures all the FAST templates are removed from the device.
